auditor_liaison: Hi team - auditor follow-up: the SOC 2 evidence export we provided for access logs (requested range 2024-11-01 -> 2025-02-01) shows a gap: no objects for 2024-12-10..2024-12-12. They need chain-of-custody + reproduction steps for that window. Can someone confirm retention/archival behavior and any export job IDs?

sam_support: thanks for flagging — assigning. can you paste the exact object prefixes the auditor saw missing?

auditor_liaison: they reported prefix s3://redwood-logs/access/yyyy=2024/mm=12/dd=12/ and similar for 11-12. export manifest attached earlier (link) - manifest shows job id exp-20241212-7f8 but the archive download failed with 404 for those dates.

maria_security: pulling access export logs now. retention policy says 365 days active, then 2yr cold archive; but we did a partial bucket transition in dec due to lifecycle rule change. might explain missing keys if lifecycle transition was mid-day. will confirm.

kevin_sre: I can repro the export job locally. export job metadata: 
```
EXPORT_JOB=exp-20241212-7f8
JOB_STATUS=completed
S3_PREFIX=s3://redwood-logs/access/yyyy=2024/mm=12/
RAN_BY=export-service-v2
```
When I run the s3 ls for that prefix I see entries up to 2024-12-09 and from 2024-12-13 onward. there's a short period missing. looking at the exporter logs: `rotate-lifecycle` ran at 2024-12-10T03:12Z and started copying to glacier-v2 bucket. some objects returned 503 during the copy and the retry logic marked them transient-failed and skipped.

sam_support: is there an audit trail for the rotate-lifecycle op? auditor wants who ran it and the command.

maria_security: rotate-lifecycle was triggered by ops runbook step from infra-team to apply lifecycle rule change. command is in runbook logs; policy change PR #983 applied at 2024-12-09T23:45Z (link to PR). ops-runbook actions are recorded in runbook-audit.log with key rotation_id=rot-20241209-3c. I will export those entries.

deploy_bot: export job artifact attached: https://artifact.internal/exp-20241212-7f8/manifest.json (signed by keystore id: ks-09ab).

kevin_sre: reproduction steps to show missing keys:
1) aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket redwood-logs --prefix "access/yyyy=2024/mm=12/" --query "Contents[?contains(Key, 'dd=12')].[Key]" --output text
2) check exporter log: kubectl logs deployment/export-service -n infra --since=72h | grep exp-20241212-7f8
3) check runbook audit: gcloud logging read "logName=projects/redwood/logs/runbook-audit AND jsonPayload.rotation_id=\"rot-20241209-3c\"" --limit 50

maria_security: for KMS/HSM proof - the manifest is encrypted with KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/ks-09ab. chain-of-custody proof: I will export the decrypt logs (KMS Decrypt events) from CloudTrail for the export job timeframe and include key rotation records. note: key rotation occurred 2024-08-01; no rotation during the suspect window.

sam_support: auditor also asked for signed deletion/transition timestamps for any objects that hit the lifecycle rule. can we produce per-object lifecycle transition records?

kevin_sre: yes — S3 lifecycle transitions are recorded in S3 Inventory and in the bucket's access logs. we can pull inventory CSV for 2024-12-09..2024-12-13 and produce a mapping. quick snippet to pull inventory file: 
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-inventory/access-inventory/2024-12-10/inventory.csv.gz - | gunzip | grep "yyyy=2024/mm=12/dd=12"
```
I will attach the CSV extract.

maria_security: plan to provide the auditor:
- export job manifest (signed) for exp-20241212-7f8 (attached)
- runbook-audit logs showing who applied lifecycle change (PR + operator)
- CloudTrail KMS decrypt events for export timeframe
- S3 inventory extract showing transitions
- worker/exporter logs showing 503 retries and the skip decision
I expect to assemble and deliver by 2025-03-05 17:00 UTC.

auditor_liaison: that timeline works. we also need a short repro playbook for the auditor to run (they may request a replay). can you include exact CLI commands + expected output and a note on why certain objects were skipped?

kevin_sre: will add a replay script and a `why-skipped.md` that explains the exporter retry threshold behaviour (skips after 5 transient failures to avoid blocking whole export). will include sample log lines.

jen_product: FYI - tagging this for product since customer reported billing spike due to re-export attempts in Jan. might be related.

sam_support: creating ticket RED-56321 and linking to auditor packet. will update when artifacts uploaded.

auditor_liaison: thanks all — please ping here when uploaded. auditor expects signed manifest + CloudTrail extract + inventory CSV. :thumbsup:
